description: This file defines the AwsClientInterface PHP interface, which specifies the methods that an AWS client class must implement, including command creation, execution, and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: AwsClientInterface
classes.description: Interface that defines the methods for an AWS client, including command execution, configuration, and resource management.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Dynamically handles calls to AWS commands, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a command object for a specified operation with given arguments.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Executes a given command asynchronously and returns a promise.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with the AWS credentials.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the region configured for the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the default endpoint URI for the client.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the service description associated with the client.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a specific or all configuration options for the client.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Provides the handler list used for transferring commands.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator resource for a specified AWS operation.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator resource for a specified AWS operation.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Waits until a resource reaches a particular state as defined by a waiter.

methods.name: getWaiter
methods.description: Returns a waiter object that waits asynchronously for a resource to reach a state.
